title: One purely inseparable coefficient-root construction decreases the inseparable degree
statement: Let k and K be fields [def-pc-field-extension] in the same universe with K/k finitely generated. Let s be a finite transcendence basis [def-weil-pbc-transcendence-basis], assume K/k(s) is finite, and suppose its inseparable degree [K : K_s] is not one, where K_s is the relative separable closure [def-weil-pbc-relative-separable-closure] of k(s) in K. There exist fields l and L in that universe and a commuting square k → l → L, k → K → L, with l/k and L/K finite purely inseparable [def-weil-pbc-finite-purely-inseparable-extension], such that L/l is finitely generated and admits a finite transcendence basis t with L/l(t) finite and [L : L_s] < [K : K_s], where L_s is the relative separable closure of l(t) in L.

source.place: Algebra, Tag 04KM, the coefficient-root construction and strict degree decrease in the induction step; steps 4–9 of lem-weil-pbc-make-separably-generated

proof.text: Write E=k(s). Use separableClosure.eq_top_iff and isSeparable_iff_finInsepDegree_eq_one to find x outside K_s=separableClosure E K. The extension K/K_s is purely inseparable. Choose an exponential characteristic p of k and hence of E and K_s. Among exponents n with x^(p^n) in K_s choose the least. It is positive; its penultimate power beta is outside K_s and beta^p is inside K_s. If p=1 these two conclusions contradict one another; therefore p is prime and k has characteristic p. This entire shortest-chain argument is proved in the private helper beta_exists.

Apply the coefficient-root extension theorem to the arbitrary polynomial P=minpoly E (beta^p) and the algebraic independence supplied by the given transcendence basis. Obtain finite purely inseparable l/k and L/K, an algebraically independent finite tuple t over l, a commuting E→E₁=l(t)→L tower, p-th-power coefficients in E₁, and the equality saying that K and E₁ generate L. This construction asserts no degree comparison.

Apply the compositum rank bound to the field range of K→L over E. Transport its rank through AlgHom.equivFieldRange and use adjoin E₁ range(K→L)=top. This gives rank E₁ L≤rank E K. The latter rank is finite, so L/E₁ is finite. Algebraicity over the intermediate field E₁ is equivalent to algebraicity over the subalgebra generated by t; together with algebraic independence this proves that t is a transcendence basis. Finally K/k finitely generated and L/K finite imply L/k essentially of finite type; enlarging the base to l gives L/l essentially of finite type, equivalently finitely generated as a field. These deductions are proved in Lean; no new holes are left.

The element beta^p is separable over E because it belongs to K_s. Map it into L; minimal polynomials are unchanged under the injective E-algebra homomorphism K→L. Apply the existing source theorem IsSeparable.of_pow_of_coeffs with exponent e=1 and the coefficient-root condition. Thus the image of beta is separable over E₁. This replaces the longer route through a p-th root in the relative separable closure.

Put S=separableClosure E₁ L and A=K_s joined with E(beta), as an intermediate field of K/E. Every element of K_s maps into S by separability under embedding and enlargement of the base. The preceding step puts beta in S as well, so A maps into S. Since beta is outside K_s, K_s<A. The original compositum equality implies that K and S generate L, because E₁⊆S. Apply the field-range compositum bound with F=A to get [L:S]≤[K:A]. Mathlib IntermediateField.finrank_lt_of_gt gives [K:A]<[K:K_s]. Composing the two inequalities proves the required strict inseparable-degree decrease. The field maps into S, scalar tower, compositum equality and inequalities are all written and proved in the private helpers compositum_finrank_le and insep_lt_of_new_separable_element.

Package the constructed fields and commuting scalar towers with the finite generation, transcendence-basis, finiteness and strict degree inequality proved above. The types and every binder of the original theorem are unchanged.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_inseparableDegree_drop
    (k K : Type w) [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    (hfg : (⊤ : IntermediateField k K).FG) (s : Finset K)
    (hs : IsTranscendenceBasis k ((↑) : s → K))
    [Module.Finite (IntermediateField.adjoin k (s : Set K)) K]
    (hne : Field.finInsepDegree (IntermediateField.adjoin k (s : Set K)) K ≠ 1) :
    ∃ (l : Type w) (hl : Field l) (akl : Algebra k l)
      (L : Type w) (hL : Field L) (aKL : Algebra K L) (alL : Algebra l L)
      (akL : Algebra k L) (htl : IsScalarTower k l L) (htK : IsScalarTower k K L),
      Module.Finite k l ∧ IsPurelyInseparable k l ∧
      Module.Finite K L ∧ IsPurelyInseparable K L ∧
      (⊤ : IntermediateField l L).FG ∧
      ∃ t : Finset L, IsTranscendenceBasis l ((↑) : t → L) ∧
        Module.Finite (IntermediateField.adjoin l (t : Set L)) L ∧
        Field.finInsepDegree (IntermediateField.adjoin l (t : Set L)) L <
          Field.finInsepDegree (IntermediateField.adjoin k (s : Set K)) K
